text.p: Frontline Ltd, the Bermuda-based tanker owner, reported first half net profit rose to $1.708 million compared with a net loss of $6.086 million in the same period a year earlier.
Frontline said it expected a "significant improvement" in results in the third quarter due to the stronger tanker markets.

Results for the first half included costs of $3.5 million linked to the shift in the group's domicile to Bermuda from Sweden following acquisition of a majority stake in the company by Norwegian shipowner John Fredriksen last year.
First half operating profit before interest expenses, depreciation and amortisation was $25.4 million compared with $9.8 million last time.
-- Julian Bray, Reuters Shipping Desk, +44 171 542 4087/4012. Fax 542 5017.
